description:
Delete this job's images now — the copy of your image the job worked from, the result and its copy without marks, its preview, and any kept copy — rather than waiting for them to expire on schedule. A job you shared leaves the gallery with them. The file you uploaded is not part of the job: it is deleted on its own, shortly after the upload.

Not reversible: call this only after the user has said to.
